verdict.rationale: A public data API is a fair question for a government corporate registry, so the axis applies. Corporations Canada's own pages document only web-based Online Filing Centre and PDF/email channels, with no published endpoints, key-issuance path, or rate limits. The probe found the registry documents no API on any surface checked. A keyless CKAN endpoint exists on the separate national open.canada.ca portal, but that is not the service's own documented API.
